description_en: Retrieves the audit trail delivery configuration
description_zh: 获取操作审计数据投递
name: GetServiceTrail

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the region in which the instance resides. Valid values:

cn-hangzhou: China (Hangzhou)
ap-southeast-1: Singapore
parameters.help_zh:
要查询的实例所在地域的ID。取值：

cn-hangzhou：中心
ap-southeast-1：新加坡
parameters.name: region_id

RequestId.description_en: The ID of the request. The system generates a unique identifier for each request. You can use the ID to troubleshoot issues
RequestId.description_zh: 本次调用请求的ID，是由阿里云为该请求生成的唯一标识符，可用于排查和定位问题

Config.description_en:
The enabling status of the service trail. Valid values:

on: Enabled.
off: Shutdown
Config.description_zh:
服务跟踪开启状态。取值为：

on：  开启
off：  关闭

CreateTime.description_en: The timestamp when the service trail was created. Unit: milliseconds
CreateTime.description_zh: 服务跟踪创建时间戳，单位毫秒

UpdateTime.description_en: The timestamp when the service trail was last updated. Unit: milliseconds
UpdateTime.description_zh: 服务最近更新时间戳，单位毫秒
